C-0038.text: After reading negative Nordace reviews or the brand's public replies on Reddit, several would-be buyers said or implied they would not buy or would hold off (one reported about a partner); these are intentions, not verified non-purchases, and the reply-driven ones cluster in two threads.

C-0010.text: Other Nordace owners in several threads report years of use, repeat purchases, or colleagues buying after seeing their bag.
C-0010.scope_limits: Mostly backpacks; one owner mentions loving a Siena tote; individual reports, not a durability rate.

C-0052.text: The product copy for the Siena Lévant Tote Bag lists a 14-inch EVA laptop sleeve, a detachable lining, a magnetic fleece pocket, a hidden anti-theft pocket, a luggage strap and an adjustable strap.
C-0052.scope_limits: Revision of C-0049 using only text that names the product; listed features, not tested.

C-0012.text: One shopper who planned to buy the Nordace tote decided against it because the brand's reviews were not great.
C-0012.scope_limits: One person; the tote is named only as 'the Nordace tote' (Siena tote thread), not the Lévant.

ACH-0004.question: Why do would-be buyers turn away from Nordace after reading Reddit?

hypotheses.statement: Owner reports about product quality or failures are what turns them away.
The brand's public replies on Reddit (two different replies, in threads 18nj9sk and bqe83z) are what turns them away.
General suspicion of ad-driven DTC brands (retargeting, resetting timers, paid-looking reviews) makes them look for reasons to stay away.
Reports about customer service, refunds and returns (unanswered emails, refused returns, partial refunds) are what turns them away.

ACH-0004.preference_reason: In this evidence the brand's public replies are the reason people state most explicitly: five comments across two threads, about two different replies, including an owner whose zippers broke who says the reply, not the failure, turned them away (E-0026). This is concentrated in two threads, so it says nothing about how often it happens elsewhere. Product-quality reports (H1) and service and returns reports (H4) also appear, but the comments that cite only generic negative reviews (E-0071, E-0094) cannot tell H1 and H4 apart; they do show rejections without any brand reply, so H2 is not the only driver. H3 explains why people go and check rather than what they decide.

ach_audit.issues: Minor: E-0002 comes from an actual buyer, not a would-be buyer, so it supports H3 and H4 only as a report others might read. E-0041 is shared by H1 and H4 and tells them apart no better than E-0071 and E-0094 do. E-0062 has no parent text, so the claim of 'two different replies' depends on E-0060 and E-0062 being in a different thread from the 18nj9sk reply, which they are, but which reply E-0062 answers is unverified. E-0071 sits in a reply thread. H4's MEDIUM diagnosticity is generous given only these two mixed items. The statement that the zipper owner was turned away by 'the reply, not the failure' is a fair reading of E-0026 but not their exact words.
